name: A-B loop
author: Rona
description: Loops a part of what plays. Press the button once for the start, again for the end, and a third time to stop.

permissions.playback.read: Knows where you are when you set the start and end
permissions.ui.osd: Shows where the loop starts and ends
permissions.input.actions: Lets you set the loop with a key

children.label: Show the loop points on the video
